research_question: After P3o-G's invalid NaN loss is excluded, can a finite-valid, bounded delay residual with compound-group CVaR reduce cross-identity predicted-gate worst-combination error relative to both F_base and its equal-capacity mean-loss control without changing the F recognizer?

identity_protocol.identity_pairing: receiver_noise_seed grouped across every regime and power view
forbidden: all prior P3o identities including P3o-G 1230M/1240M

methods.F_base: Selected local STFT plus adjacent-frame phase-increment ParameterMatchedMultiView, with BCEWithLogits plus 0.1 masked SmoothL1.
methods.H0_bounded_mean: Frozen state-preserving F plus the P3o-G bounded posterior-gated delay residual. Per-sample SmoothL1 first boolean-indexes valid finite positive targets, so inactive NaNs never enter the loss operator.
methods.H1_bounded_combo_cvar: Exactly H0 capacity, F state, initialization, data order, optimizer, training budget and checkpoint rule, with upper-tail equal-weight compound-label-group CVaR added to the finite-valid per-sample mean loss.
methods.causal_scope: Only the parameter residual may change. F state/buffers/logits, thresholds and predicted labels must be bitwise invariant.

base.checkpoint: C_joint: maximum early macro-AUPR among epochs within 1.01 of minimum early oracle macro NMAE

side.checkpoint: minimum early oracle worst-compound-group NMAE, applied identically to H0/H1

training.calibration: Fit the F threshold vector only on calibration identities and reuse it verbatim for H0/H1.

decision_rule: Any P3o-H development failure freezes H1 and consumes 1270M/1280M. No hyperparameter, checkpoint, threshold, scale, CVaR weight or identity result may be tuned. Only all-gate pass permits the single pre-registered 1290M confirmation; locked test remains forbidden until two unchanged-method confirmations pass.
